methodology: Paired Window Block Resampling & Bootstrap (10,000 iterations, Seed 42)
temporalOverlapNote: Signals at t, t+1, t+2 with 3-candle expiry share underlying price paths. Resampling operates at the window block level to respect temporal clustering.
epistemicInterpretation: While the directional asymmetry against the reversed mirror is statistically robust (p < 0.001), the absolute edge remains economically negative.
